designs.name: Pumpkin Patch
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production-quality full-body costume design illustration for Karate Bunnies. Reference image: existing approved bunny character lineup; match its soft rounded chibi bunny anatomy, oversized ears, fluffy white fur, expressive large dark eyes, tiny paws, painted fabric shading and clean dark outlines. Show ONLY ONE WHITE-FUR bunny, no lineup or extras. Identical friendly karate guard pose facing three-quarter right, both small fists near chest, feet planted, ears fully visible, centered with generous transparent padding. Outfit is a true karate gi jacket and trousers with a BLACK BELT and BARE PAWS, matching headband with short flowing tails. Spooky cute Halloween collection: cozy and playful, never scary. Keep clothing practical for animation: no dangling props, no shoes, no hat, no cape, no changes to bunny identity. Strong readable broad color blocks; limited tiny decoration; preserve pink ear interiors and nose. Transparent background, no ground rectangle, no text or labels, no watermark. Costume spec: Warm pumpkin-orange gi, dark moss-green lapel piping and sleeve cuffs, matching orange headband with one small embroidered green leaf, a single small smiling pumpkin patch on the left chest.
